notes.title: Release: June 17, 2025
notes.content:
White Vortex Games is thrilled to announce the official release of Dreamians: Card Battle on Steam for Windows PC on June 17, 2025. This strategic card game invites players to choose, evolve, and battle with unique creatures called Dreamians, blending deck-building mechanics with dynamic turn-based combat. With stunning visuals and deep gameplay, Dreamians: Card Battle promises an immersive experience for both casual and hardcore players.

Explore a vibrant world where strategy and creativity collide. Build your ultimate deck from over 100 cards, each featuring beautifully designed Dreamians with distinct abilities. Every match offers endless replayability and excitement.

Wishlist Dreamians: Card Battle now on Steam and stay updated via White Vortex Games’ official website. Prepare to duel, evolve, and save the world of dreams when the game launches next month!

notes.title: New Demo Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I’m Renan, founder of White Vortex Games, and I’m thrilled to share some exciting news with you: development is nearly complete!

To give you a taste of what’s coming, I’ve just released a brand-new demo featuring all the key mechanics you’ll see in the final game. Here’s what you can experience:

[b]3 Unique Characters:[/b] Choose between Dragnis, Wolfae, or Kalek, each with their own playstyle.

[b]Dynamic Evolution: [/b]Unlock Super and Mega transformations mid-battle!

[b]Deep Card System: [/b]Strategize with over 100 cards, combining them for powerful synergies.

[b]Progression & Rewards: [/b]Level up, unlock bonuses, and take on 10+ challenging enemies.

[b]Explore the Forest:[/b] Dive into the first available map and test your skills.

This demo is a sneak peek at the full experience—I’d love to hear your feedback!

The official release date is coming soon, so stay tuned for more updates. Your support means everything as I continue creating new games.

Try the demo now on Steam and let me know what you think!

Thank you for being part of this journey.

[b]Renan[/b]
White Vortex Games

notes.title: We'll be at BGS 24
notes.content:
Dreamians: Card Battle will be present at Brasil Game Show, the largest gaming event in Latin America. For the first time, the public will be able to experience the long-awaited game demo, offering a glimpse into the fascinating world of Dreamians and its thrilling strategic card battles. The game promises to immerse players in a unique universe, filled with distinctive characters and innovative mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047758/69da3e4cccdc43a8a6b47beff5531052f8d07567.png[/img]

Expectations for the presentation are high, especially with Brasil Game Show attracting more than 300,000 visitors. The Dreamians booth will be a standout, where players of all levels will have the chance to test their skills, explore strategies, and dive into the dynamic battles of the game. The experience promises to captivate both card game fans and those looking for new trends in the gaming world.

This participation at BGS will be an important milestone in the game's launch process, which has not yet been scheduled, creating great anticipation for what lies ahead for White Vortex studio. We hope to see you at our booth, which will be located in the indie area of the event. BGS will take place at Expo Center Norte in São Paulo, Brazil, from October 9 to 13, 2024.

notes.title: Dream Jewels and their effects. See here.
notes.content:
Hello!

This is Renan, developer of Dreamians: Card Battle.

In Dreamians: Card Battle, besides fighting against nightmares to save the dream world, you can earn artifacts called Dream Jewels that grant special powers to the Dreamians used in battle. These powers can cause positive or negative statuses.

Here are some jewels that can be used in battle:

Get Better:
Heals 5 Health Points at the end of each battle.

Gold Shield:
Adds 5 Defense Points every 4 rounds.

REM Eyes:
Deals 10 damage to an enemy every six rounds.

God Hand:
Protects the Dreamian for the first three rounds.

There are dozens of Dream Jewels to obtain throughout the journey. Each with its specific effect.

I hope you liked the ideas and see you in the dream world.

Renan Barreto
Game Dev

notes.title: Come meet the Dreamians!
notes.content:
Hello!

This is Renan, developer of Dreamians: Card Battle.

We are embarking on a journey in the world of dreams to bring a fun game concept. A card battle game featuring characters that can evolve and gain new abilities in the midst of battles.

Gradually, you will learn more about them and their evolutions. Dragnis, Wolfae, and Kalek are the three protagonists who need to rid the dream world of the Dream Travelers, powerful creatures that will torment everyone on the planet.

Humans can interact with the Dreamians only when they sleep. So, when you rest, know that you might not remember, but you have been with us in constant battles to save the dream world itself. And may we save it! After all, what would life be without dreaming?

The game has been in development for some time and I should have more news soon.

Let's continue together, fellow dreamers.

Until next time.

Renan Barreto
Game Dev
